hero.title: 🐹 Guinea Pig Name Generator
hero.tagline: Boy and girl guinea pig names, one at a time or in matched pairs.

article.intro: Guinea pigs are happiest in pairs, so most new owners need two names that sound good together. This **guinea pig name generator** gives single names or matched pairs, like Parsley & Dill or Crumble & Rumble, for boys, girls or a mix. Pick a style, from cute, funny, food and human names to names for white, black, black and white, brown and skinny pigs.

sections.heading: Eight good guinea pig names
sections.content:
All eight came from the generator, singles and pairs:

  • Wheekabelle: cute, and named after the wheek sound guinea pigs make when they want food.
  • Count Wheekula: a funny name for a guinea pig who only comes out after dark.
  • Duchess Marjoram: a herb name with a grand title.
  • Chestnut Charlie: for a brown guinea pig.
  • Hippo Harry: for a skinny pig, the almost hairless kind.
  • Cardamom & Nutmeg: a pair of spices.
  • Ink & Quill: a pair for two black guinea pigs.
  • Crossword & Domino: a black and white pair.

sections.heading: Naming a pair
sections.content:
The RSPCA says guinea pigs get lonely and shouldn't be kept alone, so most owners name two at once. Pair names that match make them easier to remember, and they're more fun to say together. There are a few ways to match them:

  • By theme: two herbs, two puddings, two spices (Cardamom & Nutmeg).
  • By sound: names that rhyme or chime (Wheeze & Breeze).
  • By looks: one dark and one light, or two that suit their colours (Ink & Quill).

Check the two names don't sound too alike on their own, though. If you'll call one at a time, names that start with different sounds are easier for them and for you.

For a smaller pet, try the Hamster Name Generator.

sections.heading: Boars and sows
sections.content: A male guinea pig is a boar and a female is a sow. Many pairs are two sows or two boars, or a neutered boar with a sow. Choose Boy or Girl to match. Plenty of the names, especially the food and colour ones, work for either.

sections.heading: Names by colour
sections.content: Guinea pigs come in many colours and coat patterns, so naming one after its looks is an easy start. White guinea pigs suit snowy or creamy names (Sir Cream Puff), black ones inky or night-time names (Liquorice Lily), and black and white ones names with stripes or patterns (Bowler Bob). Skinny pigs, which are almost hairless, get names that make the most of their wrinkles, like Wrinkly Walter.

faqs.question: What are good names for a pair of guinea pigs?
faqs.answer: Pick two names that match by theme, like two herbs (Basil & Tarragon) or two puddings (Custard & Trifle), or by sound, like Wobble & Gobble. Choose Matched pair above, and Boy or Girl if you have two boars or two sows.

faqs.question: Do guinea pigs know their names?
faqs.answer: Many do. Guinea pigs soon learn that a voice and a sound mean food, and will wheek when they hear their name or the fridge door. Short names with a clear sound, said the same way each time, are easiest for them to pick out.

faqs.question: What is a good name for a boy guinea pig?
faqs.answer: Something with character: Captain Carrot, Bowler Bob or Chestnut Charlie. Choose Boy (boar) and a style above for more.

faqs.question: What is a good name for a skinny pig?
faqs.answer: Lean into the wrinkles and the bare skin: Hippo Harry, Wrinkly Walter or Little Satin. Choose Skinny pig for more.

faqs.question: Can I use these names for rabbits too?
faqs.answer: Yes. The food, colour and human names suit rabbits and other small pets just as well.
